Messwert.Meldungstext: \TThe shift forks for 1st and 3rd gear are operated with multiplexer valve N92 and solenoid valves N88 and N90. Travel sensor 1 -G487 determines current position:\L\B\K\N ~10mm\L\S\K\N = 1st gear engaged\L\B\K\N ~ 0 mm\L\S\K\N = neutral\L\B\K\N ~ \L\B\K\A-\L\B\K\N10mm\L\S\K\N = 3rd gear engaged.\Y\F\J\N Y\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\K\IOnce the gear is engaged, the shift fork is de-pressurised.

\TThe shift forks for 2nd and 4th gear are operated with multiplexer valve N92 and solenoid valves N90 and N91. Travel sensor 1 -G488 determines current position:\L\B\K\N ~10mm\L\S\K\N = 4th gear engaged\L\B\K\N ~ 0 mm\L\S\K\N = neutral\L\B\K\N ~ \L\B\K\A-\L\B\K\N10mm\L\S\K\N = 2nd gear engaged.\Y\F\J\N Y\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\K\IOnce the gear is engaged, the shift fork is de-pressurised.

\TThe shift forks for 1st and 3rd gear are operated with multiplexer valve N92 and solenoid valves N88 and N89. Travel sensor 1 -G490 determines current position:\L\B\K\N ~ 10mm\L\S\K\N = 5th gear engaged.\L\B\K\N ~ 0 mm\L\S\K\N = neutral\L\B\K\N.\Y\F\J\N Y\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\K\IOnce the gear is engaged, the shift fork is de-pressurised.

\TThe shift forks for 6th and reverse gear are operated with multiplexer valve N92 and solenoid valves N90 and N91. Travel sensor 1 -G487 determines current position:\L\B\K\N ~10mm\L\S\K\N = 6th gear engaged\L\B\K\N ~ 0 mm\L\S\K\N = neutral\L\B\K\N ~ \L\B\K\A-\L\B\K\N10mm\L\S\K\N = reverse (R) engaged.\Y\F\J\N Y\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\K\IOnce the gear is engaged, the shift fork is de-pressurised.

\TThe gearbox oil temperature sender -G93 is built-in to the mechatronics unit and is continuously flushed by the gearbox oil. \Y\F\J\N Y\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\K\N \L\S\K\IAt gearbox oil temperatures above 138°C the mechatronics unit reduces the engine torques.

Messwert.Meldungstext: \TThe temperature sender in the control unit -G510 is built-in to the mechatronics unit and is continuously flushed by the gearbox oil. \Y\F\J\N Y\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\K\N \L\S\K\IAt gearbox oil temperatures above 138°C the mechatronics unit reduces the engine torques.

\TThe sender -G509 measures the oil temperature directly at the oil outlet from the multi-plate clutches.\Y\F\J\N Y\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\K\IAt over 145°C the multi-plate clutches K1 and K2 are no longer supplied with oil pressure and opened.
